## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible change or documentation improvement. Link an issue when one exists.

## Validation

List the checks you actually ran and their results. For native work, include OS/architecture and desktop QA. For documentation, describe link/example/image checks. State remaining gaps.

## Screenshots

For UI changes, add screenshots or a short recording with synthetic data. Remove this section when not applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] This PR has one coherent scope and targets `main`.
- [ ] I followed CONTRIBUTING.md and the relevant architecture constraints.
- [ ] I ran the checks appropriate to the change, and explained unverified behavior.
- [ ] Any tests that mutate files or Git state use isolated temporary fixtures.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation and included no private data or generated bundles.
- [ ] New dependencies or copied material have compatible licensing and required notices.
